assertions.name: sign_block_cross_anchor_consistent
assertions.source: Sign-block hypothesis cross-anchor stable to within ±100 ppb both anchors.

description: Item 1 follow-up of PR #1645: discriminate which 1-dim Wedderburn block of H_3 hosts the proton's (α_em/π) EM correction. Tests cross-anchor invariance and stages a Lean §3b-cond conditional-class statement. Sign rep is the natural Fermi-statistics choice.

data.verdict: CROSS-ANCHOR CONSISTENT. Both 1-dim Wedderburn blocks (sign V_(1,1,1) and trivial V_(3)) match the (α_em/π)/6 form at 54 ppb residual at both anchors. Numerical discrimination is not possible — they have identical Plancherel weights. The PHYSICAL discrimination is: proton color singlet = antisymmetric → SIGN rep is the natural Fermi-statistics channel. OPEN: Lean §3b-cond formalization of the conditional class ProtonMassEMSignBlock; Bring zero-mode derivation of the bare per-block (α_em/π); residual 54 ppb characterization.
